messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — billing.metering.token_drift detected
incident-bot: Severity=P1. Region=ap-northeast-1. Drift=18% vs shadow counts. Suggested runbook: billing/01-token-drift. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1718209999
carol: Oncall (carol) taking this. Starting triage — will check KV cache + emitter paths.
bob: Seeing same in aggregator: live vs shadow diverged around 2024-06-14T00:42Z. Spike aligns with a regional route change.
alice: No runtime deploys at that time from infra, but I see a traffic re-route job completed at 00:39 UTC (infra-deploy-624).
erin: Quick check — any change to emitter batching or quantization profiles?
bob: Not emitter config. Looks like some requests were routed to a new proxy pool with reduced acking; inflate seen in aggregator.
carol: Running quick query:
carol: ```sql
SELECT minute, SUM(tokens_live) AS live, SUM(tokens_shadow) AS shadow
FROM metering.aggregates
WHERE region='ap-northeast-1' AND ts >= now() - interval '20 minutes'
GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute DESC LIMIT 5;
```
carol: Query result excerpt: "2024-06-14T00:44Z live=1,124,980 shadow=948,760 (18.6%); 00:43 live=980,123 shadow=985,001 (-0.5%)"
alice: That pattern suggests an intermittent duplicate-emitter or misrouted fanout starting 00:44.
dave: Support: any customer-facing impact yet? No billing emails triggered but overage flags might flip if counts persist.
frank: Customer-success — prepping a heads-up for top 5 customers in ap-northeast-1. No invoice changes yet, just FYI.
carol: Triage actions: 1) Roll-back infra route change to previous pool (in progress by alice). 2) Pause non-critical backfills & replay consumers (dave/ops). 3) Enable shadow-only audit mode for affected namespaces. 4) Open billing ticket BI-1234 for reconciliation.
alice: Rollback started -> `infra rollback infra-deploy-624` :white_check_mark:
carol: Pause backfills: `kafka-consumer group pause --group=backfill-apne1` :white_check_mark:
dave: Notifying support page template -> "We're investigating delayed/dropped usage reports in ap-northeast-1; possible transient overage flags. We'll update in 30m." :envelope_with_arrow:
bob: After rollback, delta dropping: 00:50 live=1,010,002 shadow=998,900 (~1.1%). Monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood/metrics/metering/ap-northeast-1
erin: Can we add a temporary defense — dedupe at aggregator by request_id for last 15m window?
alice: I'll deploy a hotfix to aggregator to assert idempotency for the region (small change, rolling to one pod now).
carol: Oncall note: escalate to ENG-ML if drift reappears post-rollback. Assigning to erin and bob. Creating incident channel #inc-1718209999.
frank: I sent heads-up to top customers and SLA owners. Keeping message non-actionable until we confirm reconciliation plan.
carol: Next update in 10m. Current impact: potential short-lived overage flags for a subset of customers; no billing processed yet. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-1718209999. Pager cleared? No — monitoring still at 1.1% drift. Continue watch.
carol: Closing handoff to nightwatch (alice) for 2h monitoring window, oncall->alice. If drift >5% again, re-open pager and escalate to SRE lead.
alice: Acknowledged. Leaving monitoring alarms at higher sensitivity. I'll capture logs and attach to BI-1234.
frank: Thx — will follow up with customers once BI-1234 has reconciliation ETA. :thumbsup:
